actions.action: Check petals for grey fuzz or soft wet brown patches vs dry papery petals
Move plant to a cool spot (8–15°C) with bright indirect light, e.g. north/east window or cool room
Keep in shade on balcony and bring indoors before afternoon warms up
Water at soil level only when top centimetre is dry, draining excess
Remove spent/damaged flowers and dying leaves at base with clean scissors
